nodes.label: CodeRabbit (AI code review)
nodes.rationale: AI-powered code reviewer that cuts review time and bugs in half; configured with review profile, path instructions for TypeScript/React best practices, and auto-review settings.

nodes.label: UndanganAI (AI Wedding Invitation)
nodes.rationale: Store each invitation as html_template + vars + theme so users can edit text/photos without re-calling the AI; AI cost is paid once and templates re-render with new vars.

nodes.label: Next.js Boilerplate Starter
nodes.rationale: Boilerplate prioritizing developer experience first, bundling Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and a curated set of services and tooling.

nodes.label: HTML template + vars + theme architecture
nodes.rationale: Template contains no real content; content lives only in vars, so users edit any text/photo without another AI call and the same template re-renders with new vars.

nodes.label: Server-side rendering pipeline
nodes.rationale: Render html_template with vars via Mustache, wrap in a fixed shell with OG tags and CSS custom properties, and cache per (slug, updated_at).

nodes.label: Template validator and sanitizer
nodes.rationale: Validate required sections/placeholders, reject triple-mustache and dangerous markup, sanitize HTML/CSS with allowlists, and fall back to a base template after retries.
